text:
Nina: quick design check — compact action buttons in the sidepanel table are getting their focus outline chopped off on the bottom. noticed on both staging and prod.
Cal: repro steps? which sidepanel and density token?
Nina: Sidepanel -> integrations list, compact density (row-height 34px). Tab to the kebab or copy icon and the bottom of the outline is gone.
Ivy: looked at CSS: buttons are visually aligned by shifting with `transform: translateY(-2px)` and the tr uses `overflow: hidden`. translate + overflow = clipped outline.
Rob: oof. we've used translate/negative margin shims a lot for pixel perfection. We should prefer layout-safe approaches.
Kai: options: 1) remove overflow hidden from rows (risky for dropdowns) 2) stop using transforms for alignment and switch to padding/line-height 3) render focus as an inner ring (inset) or as a contained box-shadow.
Ivy: inset focus is readable but less obvious in compact lists. prefer a contained outer halo that doesn't escape the row. CSS example: `button.icon:focus { box-shadow: 0 0 0 var(--focus-halo, 3px) var(--color-focus); }` That keeps halo inside overflow:hidden.
Cal: box-shadow sounds safest. We also could support an absolutely-positioned pseudo-element inside the button to simulate an outer ring without relying on overflow.
Nina: another angle — our density token map currently has `--space-row-compact: 6px` which is too tight for a 3px halo. If we bump to 8px it fixes it but changes vertical rhythm across many tables. Not ideal.
Rob: agree. prefer a targeted fix for icon-only buttons rather than changing global row spacing.
Ivy: two additional accessibility fixes: contextual labels for icons (current `aria-label="copy"` -> `aria-label="Copy integration id: ${item.name}"`) and an inline confirmation micro-toast anchored to the icon instead of the global toast stack.
Kai: inline toast should be non-intrusive: absolute within the row, fade in/out, duration 1.2s, pointer-events:none, and `role="status" aria-live="polite"` so screen readers announce it. Keep message short: "Copied" + visually-hidden text with context for screen readers if needed.
Cal: also watch keyboard order — adding absolute elements might capture focus if not careful. Keep them non-focusable.
Nina: animation: prefer reduced-motion-safe variants. If user prefers reduced motion, show fade only and no transform.
Rob: testing checklist I suggest: compact/default/spacious densities, Chrome/FF/Safari, Mac VoiceOver, NVDA, keyboard-only walkthrough, tooltip edge cases (icons at left/right edge), and multiple quick copies to ensure toasts don't stack weirdly.
Ivy: PR plan: 1) replace translate-based vertical nudges with padding/line-height in the icon component 2) add focus box-shadow with tokenized halo size (compact:2px, default:3px, spacious:4px) 3) add contextual aria-label interpolation 4) implement inline micro-toast component for row actions.
Cal: please include before/after screenshots and a small screencap of keyboard flow. Also call out any token changes separately — don't land global row token changes in the same PR.
Nina: timeline? can we get a small scoped PR this sprint for the box-shadow + aria-labels + micro-toast?
Ivy: yes, I can open a draft branch today. will avoid touching row tokens.
DesignBot: Created task DS-1002: sidepanel table icon focus + contextual micro-toast.
Kai: i'll run quick a11y pass once draft PR is up. also will test tooltip placement logic near edges.
Nina: perfect. thanks team — ping here when the PR is ready for review. :sparkles:
DesignBot: Reminder: component review meeting Friday 3pm.
